summary: Genius Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching its Notice of Annual General Meeting for July 7, 2026. The agenda covers routine items: adoption of audited financial statements, director fee approval, re-election of directors Thomas Peter Power and Eva Maria Mantziou, reappointment of auditor Enrome LLP, and an ordinary resolution granting authority to issue shares under Singapore's Companies Act. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign is present. This is a standard annual meeting notice with no forced management change or extraordinary corporate action, so classification is None.
